fuel_consumption.source_quote: Based on our annual fuel consumption, a hypothetical 10% increase in the average price per gallon of aircraft fuel would have increased into-plane aircraft fuel cost for 2017 by $61.6 million. As of December 31, 2017 and 2016, we did not have any outstanding fuel derivatives.

instrument_type_details.notes: No outstanding fuel derivatives as of Dec 31, 2017. Company still describes hedging capabilities.

throughput.source_quote: Fuel gallons consumed 343,709 [2017] 302,781 [2016] [from 2017 Annual Report operating statistics table, in thousands]; Aircraft fuel expense increased by 37.7% from $447.6 million in 2016 to $616.3 million in 2017 due to 13.5% increase in fuel gallons consumed.
